item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "chmod +x src/cli.js
printf '{\"server\":{\"port\":80},\"enabled\":false}\\n' > /tmp/config-set-check.json
node src/cli.js --help >/tmp/help.out
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json server.port 8080 >/tmp/result1.out
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json server.port 8080 --dry-run >/tmp/result2.out
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json server.port 8080 >/tmp/result3.out
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json 'new.nested' '\"x\"' >/tmp/result4.out
npm test
printf '%s\\n' '--- result ---'; cat /tmp/result1.out /tmp/result2.out /tmp/result3.out /tmp/result4.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- file ---'; cat /tmp/config-set-check.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- git diff ---'; git diff -- src/cli.js package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git ls-files -s src/cli.js package.json; node src/cli.js set config.json x 1 >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; printf 'exit=%s stdout=' \""'$?"; cat /tmp/out; printf '"'stderr='; cat /tmp/err"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git ls-files -s src/cli.js package.json; node src/cli.js set config.json x 1 >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; printf 'exit=%s stdout=' \""'$?"; cat /tmp/out; printf '"'stderr='; cat /tmp/err"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' config.json; ls -l src/cli.js package.json; node src/cli.js set config.json x 1 --dry-run >/tmp/dry.out; cmp -s config.json /tmp/config-before 2>/dev/null; printf 'dry-run exit=%s\\n' \""'$?"; cat /tmp/dry.out'
